gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-questrial: Capture It towers, its letters almost sealed shut. Questrial's open, stencil-cut sans shapes let the tight display letters breathe beside it, so the page moves from clenched to relaxed.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada reads tall and full in its c, s and z, with clear openings at every curve. But Capture It, towering and nearly sealed, makes the heading feel closed in by comparison.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-radio-canada-bi: Radio Canada Big runs a monoline skeleton, terminals held far from the stem. Under Capture It's towering, nearly sealed letters, that open plain sans feels like a window left ajar.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-readex-pro: Capture It is tall, urban and nearly sealed, built to command. Readex Pro keeps a steady weight and broad terminal gaps, so paragraphs would flow without a snag.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-roboto: Urban and towering, Capture It has no calligraphic swelling anywhere along its letter outlines. Roboto's generous round mouths would keep paragraph after paragraph moving smoothly, with very little drama.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-saira: Capture It stands tall and sturdy, its arches matching its stems. Saira then opens things up, with see-through s shapes and rounded letters that stretch toward the top line.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-sofia-sans-semi: Lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height, with a wide entrance into every curve. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed feels light and open next to Capture It, which stays tall and nearly shut.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like constant line, with big-bodied lowercase and curve endings kept well apart. Paragraphs would feel open and easygoing, a loosened collar beside Capture It.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-sulphur-point: Capture It is towering and nearly sealed, with no swelling strokes. Sulphur Point, a plain sans with bulky lowercase and open gaps, gives the page somewhere to exhale.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-tiktok-sans: Tall and tight up top: Capture It towers, nearly sealed, while TikTok Sans lifts its x-height close to cap height. The standout is closed letters meeting a spacious open c.
